emerging_technology: A tool-using generative AI assistant that retrieves equipment manuals, alarm histories and work orders and presents cited diagnostic leads for technician review.
intended_application: Triage repeat stoppages on a carton packaging line
business_need: Shorten time to locate correct diagnostic evidence
users_stakeholders: Maintenance technicians, engineering, IT/OT and operations
capabilities_constraints: Mixed-OEM line, PDF manuals, alarm exports, CMMS work-order history, limited integration budget
risk_consequence_context: Bad guidance can delay repairs or endanger people or equipment. Technicians retain authority.
management_question: Should management pilot a read-only AI maintenance assistant on one packaging line?
